name: Omarchy Link
author: Ohm Launcher
description: Manages the connection with OhmLauncher (Android): discovers the peer on the LAN (mDNS/QR/Bluetooth), shares files, syncs clipboard and themes, backs up photos, and shares the screen. Bar-widget entry point; Panel.qml is loaded internally via Loader (Omarchy convention).

barWidget.description: Connects to OhmLauncher on Android (files, clipboard, themes, photos, screen).
